Infineon DD600N datasheet prints terminal numbers 1, 2, 3 only (no names): outline + circuit on p.4 (circuit also on p.1). DISCREPANCY: LEM LA 150-P datasheet (4 pp, v5) shows NO pin numbers. p.4 'Dimensions' (3 pins 0.6 x 0.6 mm, 'Fastening & connection of secondary') labels the three secondary pins M, -, + (left to right on the label view: M and - are the close pair, 5.1 mm apart; + is at the far end, 28 mm from M) and the 'Connection' diagram (p.4) maps them: + -> +Uc, M -> 0 V (through the measuring resistor RM, secondary current IS flows out of M), - -> -Uc. The only mention of a primary pin is generic UL text on p.2 (condition 5: 'soldering point between primary coil pin and ... the primary bus bar'); the p.4 outline and 'Mechanical characteristics' show no primary pins, only the 13.5 x 10 mm hole.
